thread:
Maya (Partner Eng): flagging an urgent blocking issue for Atlas Freight's staging run — model server crashes under load during model init. customer is on a locked image and planning go-live tomorrow.
Carlos (Platform Eng): rough symptoms? crash log?
Maya (Partner Eng): core snippet from journald: 
```
Mar 01 10:12:03 host kernel: NVRM: GPU 0000:af:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus
Mar 01 10:12:04 host kernel: pci 0000:af:00: cannot enable device
Mar 01 10:12:04 host redwood-runtime[1245]: ERROR loading model: cudaErrorUnknown
```
Also attached nvidia-smi summary they pasted: Driver 525.89, CUDA 11.8, reported mem 63/80GB but model init fails after ~45s.
Priya (Solutions): customer image tag: rnw-private-2026-01-b. They told us they didn't change BIOS/firmware after initial rack install.
Alex (PM): we need options: 1) push a hotfix image, 2) delay go-live, 3) fallback to hosted inference for first week. Customer prefers minimal downtime.
Carlos (Platform Eng): first triage: probable driver <-> kernel <-> firmware mismatch or a PCIe link/slot issue. ask infra to check riser seating and ECC errors. Also check /sys/kernel/debug/pci* for link_state.
Maya (Partner Eng): they already ran simple memtests — no ECC reported. customer said they swapped cables last week.
Carlos (Platform Eng): let's repro in lab with same image + Driver 525.89 on our R7525 and try two things: run model load loop with `--no-kv-cache` to reduce memory pressure, and run with env `REDWOOD_VERIFY_NVLINK=1` to surface nvlink handshake.
Priya (Solutions): while you repro, can we prepare an image variant with Driver 535.x + CUDA 12.1 but keep user config identical? if that fixes, we can offer a quick swap and a rollback plan.
Carlos (Platform Eng): yes, but build + smoke test will take ~6 hours. quick mitigation: switch the customer to our hosted endpoint for traffic bursts — low effort and immediate.
ops-bot: [AUTO] created deploy ticket RNW-DEP-4999 (prio: critical) assigned to eng-platform, si-field, and partner-eng.
Alex (PM): plan: A) Carlos + Maya repro in lab today (3h) B) if repro, build driver-upgrade image (6h) C) schedule a 2-hour staging swap window with Atlas tonight 21:00 PT for smoke and rollback test D) decision by 08:00 PT tomorrow.
Maya (Partner Eng): i've asked Atlas to hold traffic and confirmed they'll accept a staged swap tonight. sharing creds in the ticket. tagging @Carlos and @Priya for the window.
Carlos (Platform Eng): I'll prepare a reduced stress test (loop load x20, check dmesg for "GPU has fallen off the bus" and pci link resets). I'll also capture kernel oops if it happens.
Priya (Solutions): i'll draft a rollback runbook and customer-facing note explaining temporary hosted fallback with estimated latency/cost impact.
Maya (Partner Eng): thanks — i'll keep updates in RNW-DEP-4999 and ping here for only major status changes so execs can scan. :thumbsup:
